bio.text: Lisa Kinney is the Democratic candidate for Wyoming's U.S. House seat in 2026.
In her WyoFile election guide response, Kinney says she was born in Laramie and has lived there all her life.
She says she spent 10 years in the Wyoming State Senate, two of them as Minority Leader, and served on the Education and Judiciary committees.
She describes herself as a former librarian, attorney and financial advisor.
